text: In Montreal, the scientist André Delambre is found [crushed under a hydraulic press|images|weapons and tools], and his wife Hélène confesses but will not say why. She watches every fly in the house, searching for one with a white head. In flashback, André builds a [matter transporter in his basement|trigger|playing god], loses the family cat inside it, then steps in himself with a fly. He hides [beneath a black cloth|threat|the body turning monstrous], typing notes as the insect's instincts [creep over his mind|rules|death on a deadline].
